correctness.rationale: Every parameter is strictly positive, making the four-state chain irreducible. Solving two stationary moment balances plus autonomous occupancy gives the exact r and q and hence both error rates. The derivative has sign alpha*lambda-delta^2, yielding a unique global optimum. The reciprocal relation follows from a symmetric denominator. The standalone rational stationary linear algebra code independently passed 1296 finite parameter settings and all four master equations; unlimited quantifiers rest on the displayed proof, not enumeration.

originality.rationale: The 2011 indirect-sign primary work explicitly assumes unchanged occupancy to compute false negatives and says actual false positives require an occupancy-change model (accessible Methods pp.6–7). Our coupled four-state generator computes both conditional rates and a unique universal clearing optimum; inspected published mathematical records and accessible prior claims do not imply the theorem. This is best-knowledge originality subject to historical-priority and material-access risks.

value.rationale: The 2011 indirect-sign ecological survey paper identifies a genuine opposite-error problem and acknowledges inability to compute actual false-positive risk under changing occupancy using its fixed-occupancy method. The result supplies exact conditional error probabilities for a minimal mechanistic resetting-sign model, an extinction-rate-independent geometric-mean choice, and reciprocal equal-information lifetimes. These are nontrivial structural diagnostics for comparing marker media and clear model-specific limitations. Neither finite checks nor originality alone are taken as value proof.
